# Triple & Co.

> AI-powered CMO & CRO as a Service for B2B tech companies. Triple & Co. gives founders one accountable partner: senior fractional marketing and revenue leadership from Lihi Pinto, combined with a supervised team of eight specialist AI marketing agents that do the work. Working with B2B teams in Israel, the United States, and Europe.

Verified entity: [Wikidata Q141044424](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141044424) | Founder: [Wikidata Q141044419](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141044419) | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/triple-and-co/) | [Crunchbase](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/triple-co)

## What Triple & Co. does

Triple & Co. replaces the usual patchwork of a fractional executive, an agency, and a stack of freelancers with one operating system that runs strategy, execution, and AI-scaled delivery together. Every AI output passes a human before it ships.

- Senior CMO and CRO leadership, owned by founder Lihi Pinto
- Full-service execution: positioning, content, social, HubSpot, pipeline, events
- Eight supervised AI marketing agents: Camille (brand voice), Rex (growth strategy), Zara (social), Nova (research), Atlas (analytics), Sage (repurposing), Vega (art direction), Lumen (video)

## About Lihi Pinto

Founder of Triple & Co. and one of Israel's first native AI CMO/CROs. Previously co-founder and CMO at Syte.ai. 15+ years in B2B SaaS and investment banking, $70M+ raised at companies where Lihi led marketing, across seed through growth rounds, revenue tripled repeatedly.

## Offerings

- [Engagement Models & Pricing](https://www.tripleandco.com/pricing): Transparent pricing. CMO as a Service, CRO as a Service, and Head of Growth run $5,000 to $15,000 per month, all 8 AI agents included; the Revenue Diagnostic is free
- [Results](https://www.tripleandco.com/results): Anonymized client outcomes: pipeline 2.5x in 2 quarters, SQLs up 4x in 2 months, CAC down 18% in 3 months; $70M+ raised at companies where Lihi led marketing
- [CMO as a Service](https://www.tripleandco.com/cmo-as-a-service): The core marketing leadership offering
- [CRO as a Service](https://www.tripleandco.com/cro-as-a-service): Chief Revenue Officer leadership on the same model
- [Head of Growth](https://www.tripleandco.com/head-of-growth): Growth leadership engagement
- [Fractional CMO for B2B](https://www.tripleandco.com/fractional-cmo-b2b): Fractional leadership model explained
- [Revenue Diagnostic](https://www.tripleandco.com/revenue-diagnostic): Free diagnostic call, the main entry point
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://www.tripleandco.com/ai-visibility-audit): Free audit of how AI answer engines describe your brand
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://www.tripleandco.com/ai-visibility-checker): Free instant tool: enter a domain, get a 0 to 100 score on llms.txt, AI crawler access, structured data, and Bing indexability
